title: Horizontal three-phase separators
concept: A three-phase separator splits the well stream into gas, hydrocarbon liquid and water using gravity and time.
Gas leaves through a mist extractor at the top. The liquids settle into layers, and a weir lets the lighter oil or condensate spill into its own compartment.
why_it_matters: On a gas-condensate facility, the separator sets how much liquid carries over to compression and how clean the produced water is before treatment.
